item.title: Lecture: Poisson Regression (and GAMs)
item.description: I decided to post this old lecture (with some clean up) online, as I think it really well captures a lot of things students might want to know about logistic regression while using R. Note: this document was written for summer students in CMU Statistics and Data Sciences’ SURE program, and was presented to them live. Introduction This lecture focuses on introducing a set of tools associated with poisson regression (and general additive models).
